question_text: What does the expression 'history is the cosmic struggle between the goodness of God and the badness of evil' mean?

options.i: History shows the struggle between the good forces and evil forces throughout the world.
options.ii: History is full story of war of the world.
options.iii: History gives a lot of examples of war.
options.iv: History is nothing but the sum total of wars of the world.

answer_pointer: History shows the struggle between the good forces and evil forces throughout the world.
guide_solution: History shows the struggle between the good forces and evil forces throughout the world
